info.title: Magpi API (Outbound, REST Outbound and Inbound)
info.description: Magpi (magpi.com, formerly DataDyne) was a mobile data-collection platform. It published three APIs: the legacy XML Outbound API (form-encoded username + accesstoken; Get Surveys and Get Survey Data v1/v2, plus the v3 URL the adaptor calls), the newer JSON 'Magpi Rest Outbound API' on api.magpi.com (access token in the Authorization header), and the Inbound API used by Magpi's mobile clients to fetch XForms and upload records. Magpi discontinued operations in February 2025; every host now fails or serves a parked page, so this document is a historical record of the documented surface. The OpenFn adaptor's fetchSurveyData POSTs to https://www.magpi.com/api/surveydata/v3 and converts the XML SurveyDataList to JSON; submitRecord builds a {apiUrl}/mobileApi/uploadData URL and an XML <form> body but never sends it.

post.summary: Get Surveys: list the forms the user has data-view access to
post.description: Legacy Outbound API call 1. Returns a list of all Magpi forms for which the user has data view access; the surveyid used by Get Survey Data comes from this list. Parameters may be sent as a POST form body or as GET query parameters. The response is XML; its element names are not recoverable from the evidence available (the docs site is offline), so it is modelled as an opaque XML document.

schema.description: XML document listing forms (element names not documented in recoverable evidence).

default.description: Error (format not documented in recoverable evidence).

post.description: Legacy Outbound API call 2. Returns the submissions of one form as an XML SurveyDataList. POST (form body) or GET (query string). startdate/enddate filter on the record DateStamp, inclusive. The JSON response schema models the records after XML conversion, as the adaptor does.

200.description: SurveyData records (XML SurveyDataList upstream; JSON after XML conversion).

schema.description: Upstream body is XML: a SurveyDataList root holding one SurveyData element per record (a single element when there is one record, none when nothing matches). Modelled as the JSON array of records the adaptor produces after XML conversion and normalisation.

default.description: Error (format not documented in recoverable evidence).

post.summary: Get Survey Data (v3, as called by the adaptor)
post.description: The URL hard-coded in the adaptor's fetchSurveyData (https://www.magpi.com/api/surveydata/v3), sent as a form-encoded POST with username, accesstoken, surveyid, startdate and enddate. Not described in the recoverable docs text; modelled from the adaptor source. The adaptor parses the XML response, reads SurveyDataList.SurveyData (a single element or a list), and keeps the first record's LastSubmissionDate as the cursor for the next run.

get.summary: Get the data (answers) for a form
get.description: REST Outbound API. Gets the submitted data for the specified form. Paged with start/limit (default limit 100, maximum 500) and filterable with searchQuery. Forms with sub-form questions return sub-form answers by reference; fetch them with getSubformAnswers. Answer values may be typed objects (for example type 'image').

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Offset of the first record to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return (default 100, max 500).

default.description: Error (format not documented in recoverable evidence).

post.summary: Upload a record (add new or update existing)
post.description: Inbound API. Adds a new record or updates an existing one. The body starts with the account username and password (writeUTF in the vendor sample) followed by the record. The response is one of a set of numeric status codes (for example a code for invalid username/password); the code table is not recoverable from the evidence available.

schema.description: DataOutputStream-framed username, password and record payload.

default.description: Error (format not documented in recoverable evidence).

post.description: URL built by the adaptor's submitRecord ({apiUrl}/mobileApi/uploadData) with the record serialised as an XML <form> element. The adaptor marks the operation work-in-progress and never sends the request; the path does not appear in the recoverable Inbound API docs (whose upload call is UploadRecordsNew). Kept so every adaptor operation maps to a path.

schema.description: XML <form> element produced by js2xmlparser from the adaptor's JSON input; child elements are the form's question names.

default.description: Error (format not documented in recoverable evidence).

accessToken.name: Authorization
accessToken.description: REST Outbound API: the access token generated on the Magpi API settings page, sent as the Authorization header value.

formExternalId.name: formExternalId
formExternalId.description: External id of the form (from listForms).

CredentialsRequest.description: Legacy Outbound API credentials, sent as form fields or query parameters.

username.description: Username of the user who generated the access token.

accesstoken.description: Access token created on the Magpi API settings page.
Access token; each token is associated with the user who generated it.

surveyid.description: Numeric survey id (not the survey's name), taken from Get Surveys.

startdate.description: Optional start date; filtering is on the record DateStamp and inclusive. Same date format as the Magpi data tab.

enddate.description: Optional end date; filtering is on the record DateStamp and inclusive.

SurveyData.description: One submission record. Child elements are the form's question names (form-specific) plus record metadata; only LastSubmissionDate is evidenced by the adaptor source.

LastSubmissionDate.description: Submission timestamp the adaptor keeps as the next run's startdate (read from the first record).

Form.description: A Magpi form as returned by the REST Outbound API. Field names are not recoverable from the evidence available (docs offline); forms are addressed by their external id.

Question.description: A question of a form (REST Outbound API). Field names not recoverable from the evidence available.

Answer.description: One submitted record (REST Outbound API). Keys are question names; typed values such as images appear as objects with a type field (e.g. 'image'). Full field list not recoverable.
